{{Top|leg}}
A '''self-sharpening diagnostic mode''' was a setting incorporated into most models of [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. It was part of the weapon's design ethos that promoted durability over an extended period with a minimal amount of maintenance.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
